en.title: G.A.V.A
en.decryption: Gavyuti (distance/pasture), Ayas (metal/copper), Vraja (cow pen), Avani (earth/land). Key terms to identify pastoral nomadic roots.

hi.title: G.A.V.A
hi.decryption: Gavyuti (distance/pasture), Ayas (metal/copper), Vraja (cow pen), Avani (earth/land). Key terms to identify pastoral nomadic roots.

fact.en: Do not assume 'Ayas' refers to Iron; it signifies copper or bronze in the Rig Veda.
fact.hi: Do not assume 'Ayas' refers to Iron; it signifies copper or bronze in the Rig Veda.

fact.en: Avoid equating 'Bali' with a compulsory tax; in the Rig Vedic period, it was a voluntary offering/tribute.
fact.hi: Avoid equating 'Bali' with a compulsory tax; in the Rig Vedic period, it was a voluntary offering/tribute.

fact.en: There was no concept of private property in land; the economy was based on cattle possession.
